bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: auto-rewrite Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper -> Microsoft.UI.* (boundary-guarded so the Windows.UI.Color struct is untouched), because the bulk Windows.UI.Xaml-only rewrite left these non-Xaml helper classes to fail as CS0234/CS0103 in nearly every UWP sample.
